item.title: Father Christmas in the Castle at Castle Howard
item.description: Father Christmas, WonderPhil and the gang are travelling from the North Pole to Castle Howard for a Christmas show filled with laughter, wonder and festive cheer. After the performance, each family will enjoy their own special one-to-one moment with Father Christmas, and every child with a ticket will receive a Christm

item.title: Alpaca Festival
item.description: A festival on algorithmic pattern-making in anything from heritage crafts to tech. With an algorave, a concert with pattern-based instrumental music, talks and workshops around patterns in juggling, textiles, music and more.
